- No more blur over Shorts: the picture is clear top to bottom, with a small shadow on the text instead so it still reads
- Pull comments down to close them (from the top of the list or by the header); the Shorts don't swipe while comments are open
- Back works on Shorts like everywhere else: swipe back and the Shorts shrink away (on the Shorts tab, back goes home); back closes comments first
- Shorts in your history open in the Shorts player
